verdict.rationale: Digits documents a dedicated 'Bill Pay' feature (drag/drop/approve/pay) and a full bills workflow API covering ingest, query, submit, approve, pay, reject, and void gated by a bills:manage scope, which maps directly to capture, approval routing, and payment. However, evidence doesn't detail payment scheduling specifics (e.g., future-dated batch runs, approval chains/rules) or provide independent/hands-on confirmation the workflow works end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit payment-scheduling mechanics, multi-step approval routing configuration details, and third-party corroboration.
